name: Stick Shoulder Flexion

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: AAOS Shoulder Active-Assisted Range of Motion Protocol

steps: Lie on your back on a firm surface or bed holding a lightweight stick or cane with both hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your arms straight with the stick resting across your upper thighs and your palms facing down.
Using the strength of your unaffected arm, slowly push the stick upward and backward overhead in a smooth arc.
Guide your affected arm upward into shoulder flexion until you feel a gentle, pain-free stretch in your shoulder and armpit.
Hold the overhead position for 3 to 5 seconds.
Slowly guide the stick back down to your thighs under control.
coaching_cues: Keep your elbows straight or softly unlocked without bending them fully.
Do not arch your lower back off the floor to gain extra overhead distance.
Breathe out as you guide the stick overhead and inhale as you lower.

sources.attribution: AAOS Rotator Cuff and Shoulder Conditioning Program
